standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforward along a closed immersion is exact, so the derived pushforward is computed on any representative, and the base change map of the cartesian square can be evaluated on stalks
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the invertibility of the functor identity to a stalkwise tensor statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: The algebraic base change comparison for a compatible pair of local ring maps is an isomorphism exactly under the stated tor independence
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the displayed stalkwise tensor map with the isomorphism supplied by the More on Algebra lemma.

core_obligations: Observe the assertion is for all K in D(O_Z); since i_* and i'_* are exact, Ri_* and Ri'_* are computed by applying i_* and i'_* to any representatives, so the base change map Lf^*(Ri_*(K)) to Ri'_*(Lg^*(K)) can be inspected on stalks (proof lines 5567-5575).

Write the stalk at z' in Z' over z in Z as the map K_z tensor^L_{O_{X,z}} O_{X',z'} to K_z tensor^L_{O_{Z,z}} O_{Z',z'}; by More on Algebra, Lemma base-change-comparison and the assumed tor independence of Z and X' over X this map is an isomorphism, which proves the functor identity (proof lines 5575-5584).
proof_roadmap: Use exactness of closed immersion pushforwards to reduce to stalks (proof lines 5567-5575).
Identify the stalkwise base change map with the algebraic comparison map and conclude by tor independence (proof lines 5575-5584).
